cardEffects: [Main] Trash up to 3 cards in your hand. For each card trashed by this card's effect, ＜De-Digivolve  1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) Then, delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.
name: Metal Impulse

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  This effect only activates ＜De-Digivolve  nocategory＞ (Trash up to nocategory cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) on 1 of your opponent's Digimon. For the part of the effect after "then," you can also choose a Digimon other than the target Digimon for ＜De-Digivolve  nocategory＞ (Trash up to nocategory cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.).
rulings.question: If I use this card's [Main] effect to trash 2 cards in my hand, can I activate ＜De-Digivolve  1＞ nocategory of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) on 2 of my opponent's Digimon?

rulings.answer: ＜De-Digivolve  1＞ nocategory of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) activates twice, ＜De-Digivolve  2＞ nocategory of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash up to 2 cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) doesn't activate once.  Even if a Tamer card or Option card becomes the top card after trashing the top card, ＜De-Digivolve  nocategory＞ (Trash up to nocategory cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) can trash a card regardless of its card category, therefore you go on to trash the 2nd card. However, if a card with an "isn't affected by effects" becomes the top card after the first ＜De-Digivolve  1＞ nocategory of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.), it won't be affected by the second ＜De-Digivolve  1＞ nocategory of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) and won't be trashed.
